title: Ice Upgrades
description: This mod adds upgrades to ice, like ice armor/tools and even an fridge!
body:
# Ice Upgrades
This mod adds a lot of new ice things! You can play around in singleplayer or play with your friends. With the new ice ore you can get some ice clumps. You can put it in a fridge to get ice ingots. Then you can craft ice armor or tools and a lot more! Trade with the new villager for the ice upgrade template to get a ice mace or ice totem!

## New Items/Blocks
**The new items:**
- Ice Clump
- Ice Ingot
- Ice Nugget
- Ice Armor
- Ice Tools
- Ice Apple
- Ice Carrot
- Ice Upgrade Template
- Ice Totem
- Ice Mace

**The new blocks:**
- Fridge
- Ice Ore
- Deepslate Ice Ore

## Recipes
Armor, tools, food and nuggets are crafted just like normal minecraft, but with ice ingots.

For the rest see the gallery

## Abilities
**Ice Sword:** You can give players/hostile mobs a freezing effect that will stop them from moving at all with right clicking! But there is a cooldown. You need to crit a player or a hostile mob 10 times to recharge.

**Ice Totem:** It works just like a normal totem, but you can stack it to 2 in total! 

**Ice Mace:** It is just a mace, but you do more damage in cold biomes!

## Ore Gen
The ice ore and deepslate ice ore can only generate in cold biomes and mostly generate in stone!

## The Fridge
![The normal fridge and double fridge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a36ba414659875990a40c5855641b1d14037b245.png)

You can freeze items to get a different item! It works just like a furnace. You even have a double fridge if you stack 2 on top of eachother. Then you can smelt 2 of the same items faster!

**The recipes:**
- Ice clump -> Ice ingot
- Carrot -> Ice Carrot
- Golden Apple -> Ice Apple
- Water Bucket -> Ice

## Villager - Ice Keeper
![This is the Ice Keeper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04871af6a53d1ee6531c2ed32963fc249e530159.jpeg)

This villager is obtained with a fridge.
